verdict.rationale: Square documents a dedicated Sandbox, described as a free, isolated server environment for testing Square APIs without affecting real data. The SDK quickstarts are built to run against it. This is true environment isolation, not merely a dry-run mode. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of sandbox use, and documented detail on sandbox parity, test data or test cards, and agent/MCP use against the sandbox.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: The Square Sandbox is a free, isolated server environment that allows developers to safely test Square APIs without affecting real data.
You use the Square Sandbox for the Quickstart exercise.
